decisions.title: Preserve B0 without mutation
selectedResult: All B0 semantic owners and contracts remain normative; this register is an additive delta.
decisions.migrationEffect: No migration of B0 history; every delta cites B0 and accepted scope.

decisions.title: Preserve family-specific lifecycle and denial monotonicity
selectedResult: Each policy family retains independent draft, simulation, precedence, release, rollback, retirement and uninstall proof.
External facts contribute only admitted local inputs.
decisions.migrationEffect: Migrate family artifacts by immutable generation with shadow comparison.
decisions.rollbackEffect: Restore a compatible predecessor or use forward recovery for closed compatibility edges.

decisions.title: Preserve exact invocation capability taxonomy
selectedResult: Keep CALL_RESULT_DISCLOSURE, GAS_ESTIMATE_DISCLOSURE, ACCESS_LIST_DISCLOSURE, UNSIGNED_TRANSACTION_PREPARATION, SIGNED_TRANSACTION_SUBMISSION and OPERATION_STATUS_DISCLOSURE independent.
MULTI_CALL_SIMULATION_DISCLOSURE remains deferred and default-denied.
decisions.migrationEffect: Use LegacySelectorPolicyMigrationV1 with counts, dry-run, conflict detection, atomic cutover, shadow compare and predecessor evidence.
decisions.rollbackEffect: Never collapse new effects to legacy booleans when information would be lost; use forward recovery.

decisions.title: Preserve current authorization evidence and non-authoritative observations
selectedResult: ExecutionEvidenceSessionV1 is request-scoped and immutable.
ExecutionPathObservationCandidateV1 is privacy-reduced, asynchronous and never grants.
Unknown, malformed, truncated or unowned frames fail closed, including EG-000632 and EG-000633.
decisions.migrationEffect: Shadow one shared trace session and frame-ownership ledger before activation.
decisions.rollbackEffect: Return to the compatible evidence contract; never infer authority from observations.

decisions.title: Preserve RGRA_EVENT_RELATIONSHIP_V1 and signed local relationship shards
selectedResult: Exact-key lookup binds namespace, role, entity digest, subject digest and as-of anchor.
Only MEMBER_CONFIRMED may satisfy a positive relationship condition.
Miss, stale, reorg, ambiguity, schema unavailability or epoch mismatch deny/not-ready.
decisions.migrationEffect: Validate legacy relationship state through Fact Bridge, shadow compare, then activate per exact namespace/profile.
decisions.rollbackEffect: Invalidate before replacement; deny until a compatible LocalRelationshipFactShard is ready.

decisions.title: Preserve strict and bounded dynamic-event ordering profiles
selectedResult: Strict profiles remain the default.
Bounded wait/buffer/queue profiles require signed evidence-backed budgets.
Pending references, cursors and reorg lineage are durable.
decisions.migrationEffect: Introduce bounded profiles inactive, shadow ordering and activate per exact surface/profile.
decisions.rollbackEffect: Return to strict fail-closed behavior while preserving pending references.

decisions.title: Add exact-profile Client Indexer Compatibility within existing runtime/control services
selectedResult: LS-CONTROL-API owns profile/workload/session/readiness/conformance control.
LS-PDS authorizes locally; LS-BROKER classifies methods and validates/shapes responses.
Profile identity binds Participant, project, workload, session, engine/runtime/dependencies/versions/config, method, data class, failure semantics and limits.
Unprofiled or partial matches deny.
decisions.migrationEffect: Register existing workloads, shadow method/data truth, then activate exact profiles.
decisions.rollbackEffect: Deactivate profile, fence session and return typed denial/unavailable; no raw-node or universal-empty fallback.

decisions.title: Add replaceable off-path Explorer Fact Source adapter seam
selectedResult: OpenExplorer is the preferred candidate for qualification, not an admitted default.
Adapter binds exact source instance/release/snapshot/cursor, semantic mapping, canonicality, finality, freshness, provenance, completeness and trust.
No synchronous source/database dependency is permitted on the runtime path.
decisions.migrationEffect: Run inactive acquisition and qualification; publish candidates only after exact profile admission.
decisions.rollbackEffect: Deactivate adapter, withdraw readiness and fail closed; alternate sources require independent qualification.

decisions.title: Preserve and generalize source-neutral projection and admitted-local-fact publication
selectedResult: Flow is adapter to occurrence to deterministic projection to checkpoint to Fact Bridge validation to canonical fact to signed shard to runtime capsule.
Source, candidate, canonical fact and local-shard checkpoints remain distinct.
Only READY_COMPLETE compatible local state may support a positive result.
decisions.migrationEffect: Generalize candidate adapters without changing Fact Bridge admission or runtime authority.
decisions.rollbackEffect: Restore a compatible adapter pointer or remain not-ready; never select a silent winner.

decisions.title: Add server-mediated Privacy Explorer Integration within LS-CONTROL-API
selectedResult: Sequence: bind local context, preauthorize, narrow intent, interact with separate product, validate/redact locally, release or typed failure.
Nine semantic operations and accepted data classes are independently versioned.
Browser and Explorer outputs never establish authority; OpenExplorer internals remain separate-workstream.
decisions.migrationEffect: Negotiate in dark mode, replay preauthorization/result-validation, then activate exact contract-version pairs.
decisions.rollbackEffect: Fence sessions and return typed denied/unavailable/recovery states.

decisions.title: Preserve authority, truth and claim ceilings
selectedResult: Provider, route, health, finality, evidence, source, product, schema, database, indexer, Explorer and fact observations cannot grant.
No invented numeric, SLA, capacity, accessibility-level, certification or compatibility claim.
Write ambiguity is durable and is never blindly retried or failed over.
decisions.migrationEffect: Carry observations and evidence gates forward without activating unsupported claims.

decisions.title: Keep UI as truthful presentation, not architecture authority
selectedResult: UI may display typed positive, negative, pending, stale, reorg, partial, conflict, unavailable and invalid states.
B0 screens, fields, defaults, navigation and flows are not automatically the final design.
decisions.migrationEffect: No UI redesign in SR-04; carry typed state/acceptance obligations to SR-05.
decisions.rollbackEffect: Display truthful unavailable/stale state with no optimistic success.

claimCeilings.rule: Accessibility, responsive and explainability wording is limited to the exact tested complete-process profile; no standard level or certification is asserted without complete executed evidence.

External or source data remains non-authoritative until off-path validation and local signed admission; source preference, schema or database presence never proves canonicality, completeness, freshness, trust, availability or permission.

Compatibility wording is limited to the exact client family, engine/runtime/dependency version, method, data class, configuration, limits, privacy/failure behavior, corpus and current receipt that passed qualification.

Platform, Participant, envelope, epoch, delegation, terminal and visibility denial bounds dominate; provider, route, health, finality, evidence, source, product, schema, database, indexer, Explorer and fact state never grant authority; unknown or non-qualified never means healthy.

No numeric, performance, freshness, availability, recovery, SLO/SLA, accessibility or certification claim exceeds an exact source and executed profile/workload/environment/method/data-class/corpus/time-window receipt.
P&C claims only its bounded integration contract and exact qualified product/profile tuple; OpenExplorer internal behavior and operations remain separate and unclaimed.
